AI/ML Internship Opportunity – Path to Full-Time Role 
(Paid) 
 
Company Intro: https://cogninest.ai/  
 
Location: Remote (Pune-based candidates preferred) 
We are seeking motivated AI/ML Interns to join our team and gain practical experience in 
building cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. This is an 
opportunity for individuals who are passionate about applying theoretical knowledge to real-
world problems and are eager to advance their careers in the field. 
Who Should Apply 
• Graduates from 2025 or earlier  
• Individuals eager to transition into the AI/ML field with the possibility of converting the 
internship into a full-time role 
Required Skills 
• Proficiency in Python: Strong knowledge of Python for implementing machine learning 
models and data manipulation 
• Understanding of Machine Learning and Data Science Fundamentals: Knowledge of 
algorithms, data structures, and model building techniques 
• Familiarity with Data Preprocessing and Feature Engineering: Ability to handle real-
world data for cleaning, transformation, and feature selection 
• Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to break down complex 
problems and implement solutions effectively 
• Familiarity with Deep Learning Architectures (optional but beneficial) 
Internship Responsibilities 
• Machine Learning & Natural Language Processing (NLP): Develop and implement 
machine learning models for various applications 
• Time Series Forecasting: Work with time-series data to build prediction models 
• Generative AI: 
o Work with LangChain and LangGraph 
o Fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) 
o Apply Prompt Engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 
• API Development: Build and maintain APIs using frameworks such as Flask, FastAPI, 
or Django Framework 
• Cloud Deployment: Deploy AI/ML models and applications on cloud platforms such as 
AWS or Azure

Not Ideal For 
• Candidates looking for short-term academic internships 
• Individuals who are waiting for joining dates from other offers 
What We Offer 
• A paid internship with an opportunity for full-time employment upon successful 
completion 
• Exposure to real-world AI/ML projects and technologies 
• Mentorship and guidance from experienced AI professionals 
• Hands-on experience in cloud deployment, NLP, and Generative AI
